Belongingness at Prefect is our commitment to ensuring mutual power, access, and opportunity among all groups and individuals who make up our community. We operationalize belongingness through actions large and small on a daily basis, but always with the goal that all groups and individuals can contribute as their most authentic self to the evolution of our product, our team, and our community.
Belongingness is also our commitment to bridge with individuals or groups not yet established in our community, acknowledge differences in a way that affirms distinct identities, and allows for a new, more expansive group identity to form.

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .
Working as a Senior Growth Manager supporting Reddit’s International Community team, you will develop and execute initiatives that strengthen Reddit’s user and community ecosystems in the US and across international markets.
This position is open to candidates based in the UK or the US - East Coast.
This is not a marketing role. You will identify high-impact growth opportunities, design and execute experiments, and develop successful interventions into repeatable models that can be applied across markets. Your work may include building and scaling communities, increasing the supply of relevant content and contributions, reaching underserved audiences, and strengthening Reddit’s user experience.
The role combines growth strategy, hands-on experimentation, data analysis, and cross-functional influence. You will work closely with Product, Data Science, Marketing, and Community teams while maintaining the autonomy and entrepreneurial mindset required to scale successful initiatives to other markets.

User & Community Growth Strategies: Establish and execute comprehensive strategies to grow the user base and nurture communities.
Growth Experimentation: Design and execute growth experiments aimed at addressing gaps in content supply, community density, contribution, discovery, engagement, and user growth. Apply a creative, entrepreneurial approach by testing ideas quickly, learning from results, and iterating accordingly.
Scaling and Repeatability: Translate successful experiments into repeatable playbooks, processes, and recommendations that can be applied across markets. Determine which elements can scale broadly, which require local adaptation, and what operational or product support is needed to unlock broader impact.
Data & Performance Analytics: Monitor key growth and ecosystem indicators, including DAU, contribution, content supply, community health, and retention. Analyze performance trends, identify risks and opportunities, and establish clear measurement frameworks for experiments and scaled programs.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with various internal teams to provide insights, shape priorities, and scale growth initiatives. Build compelling evidence through experimentation to influence cross-functional investment and product development.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
7+ years of experience in user growth, product operations, or market expansion, with a demonstrated track record of executing growth initiatives at scale.
Strong entrepreneurial instincts, hands-on execution skills, and the ability to make progress independently in ambiguous or resource-constrained environments.
Data-driven and analytical mindset, with proficiency in Excel modeling, working knowledge of SQL, and experience creating scalable processes and automations.
Strong systems thinking, with the ability to distinguish between market-specific problems and growth opportunities that can be addressed through repeatable approaches.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively and align cross-functional stakeholders across global teams.
Results-oriented mindset, strong attention to detail, and a bias toward execution.
Comfort balancing a portfolio of opportunities across the US and international markets and prioritizing based on potential impact, feasibility, and strategic relevance.

About Found
Found is building the leading consumer platform for medically guided weight care—combining modern obesity medicine, AI-driven personalization, and a human care team.
As one of the largest medically-assisted weight loss programs in the country, Found has served 300,000+ members and is backed by leading investors including Atomic, Google Ventures, WestCap, IVP, TCG, and Define Ventures.
The Opportunity
We’re hiring a Growth Marketing Manager to own core levers of Found’s consumer growth engine.
This is a high-impact, cross-functional role at the intersection of paid acquisition, creative strategy, lifecycle, and conversion optimization. You’ll be responsible for improving CAC, payback, and member growth across the funnel, working closely with agencies, internal teams, and leadership. In your first 6–12 months, success in this role means improving CAC efficiency, increasing lead-to-conversion rates, and launching new creative and channel strategies that drive measurable member growth.
You’ll report directly to the VP of Strategy, BizOps & Growth and help define how Found acquires and converts hundreds of thousands of future members.
What You'll Own
Paid acquisition performance across Meta, Google, TikTok, and emerging channels, in partnership with agency teams.
Creative strategy for performance marketing, including messaging, copy testing, creator briefs, and design direction.
End-to-end funnel optimization from first touch → lead → conversion → reactivation.
Lifecycle marketing strategy for pre-purchase nurture and churned-member reactivation.
Experimentation roadmap across channels, creative, landing pages, and lifecycle flows.
Core growth metrics , including CAC, payback, conversion rate, and channel-level efficiency.

Set and execute paid media strategies aligned to growth and unit-economics targets.
Analyze attribution, conversion, and cohort data to identify incremental growth opportunities.
Partner with creative, product, and agency teams to develop high-performing ad concepts and landing experiences.
Build and prioritize testing roadmaps across channels, creatives, and lifecycle flows.
Improve lead-to-conversion performance through better segmentation, messaging, and automation.
Identify and test new channels, partners, and growth initiatives.
Required Experience & Skills
4+ years of experience in growth or performance marketing roles with direct ownership of CAC, conversion, or revenue targets.
Track record improving CAC, conversion rate, or payback at a high-growth consumer or healthcare company.
Hands-on experience with major paid channels (Meta, Google, TikTok)
Experience working with agencies or external partners.
Strong analytical mindset; comfortable using data to make decisions.
Ability to operate autonomously in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
Bias toward action; comfortable launching tests quickly and iterating based on data.

Healthcare or other regulated-industry experience.
Creator or influencer marketing experience.
Lifecycle or CRM marketing experience.
Experience using AI tools to improve marketing workflows.
Former founders or early-stage startup operators encouraged.
We are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply.

Wir sind ein junges, politisch engagiertes Team, das digitale Kommunikation mit Haltung macht. Wir machen nicht nur Content – wir wollen Menschen in Bewegung bringen. Die Menschen, die uns per Mail, über Social Media oder Messaging-Kanäle folgen, sind dafür das Rückgrat: Je größer und aktiver diese Community ist, desto mehr politische Schlagkraft haben wir. Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die diese Liste an Unterstützer*innen wachsen lässt und aus ihr echte Beteiligung macht.
Als Community Growth Lead verantwortest du die technische und strategische Infrastruktur unseres Organizings: Du baust Funnel-Strukturen auf, die neue Newsletter-Abonnent*innen gewinnen, entwickelst automatisierte Journeys (z. B. über ManyChat) und sorgst dafür, dass Menschen aus einer Community zu aktiven Unterstützerinnen werden. Du denkst in Daten, Prozessen und Skalierbarkeit – und verstehst gleichzeitig, warum politisches Momentum zählt und wie man es in Aktivierung übersetzt.
Du arbeitest eng mit unseren anderen Bereichen zusammen und bringst in den täglichen Meetings eigene Ideen ein. Dabei übernimmst du Projekte eigenverantwortlich: Du entwickelst und optimierst digitale Aktivierungssysteme und konzipierst niedrigschwellige digitale Beteiligungsformate und Aktionen.
Aufgaben
Aufbau, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung unserer CRM- und Funnel-Strukturen
Konzeption und Umsetzung automatisierter digitaler Journeys (z. B. ManyChat, Mail-Flows, Chatbots)
Entwicklung von Aktivierungs-Funnels, die aus Reichweite konkrete Beteiligung machen (von Sign-up bis Aktion oder Spende)
Kontinuierliches Testen, Auswerten und Optimieren von Kampagnen anhand von Daten (A/B-Tests, Conversion-Analyse)
Inhaltliche Betreuung und technische Weiterentwicklung von Community-Kanälen (Newsletter, WhatsApp, Broadcasts etc.) – inklusive eigenständigem Verfassen von Copy für Journeys, Broadcasts und Funnel-Schritte
Enge Abstimmung mit Organizing- und Content-Team, um Reichweite in nachhaltige Mobilisierungsstrukturen zu übersetzen
Einbringen neuer Tools, Automatisierungen und technischer Trends aus dem Bereich digitales Campaigning
Qualifikation
Gespür für List Growth: Du erkennst Momentum, weißt, wie man Menschen darüber in einen Funnel zieht und sie digital motiviert hält
Praxis mit Automatisierungstools (z. B. ManyChat, N8N/Zapier/Make, Newsletter-Tools) und Freude daran, User-Journeys selbst zu bauen
Erfahrung im Umgang mit Growth- und Marketing Tools (Meta Business Suite, Airtable, Google Analytics, Google Sheets oder Datenbanksysteme)
Ausgeprägtes analytisches Verständnis: Du liest gerne Daten, ziehst Schlüsse und optimierst systematisch
Erfahrung im Bereich Lifecycle-/Funnel-Marketing, Marketing-Automation oder Growth Marketing – idealerweise im politischen oder gesellschaftlichen Kontext
Affinität und Fähigkeit sich selbständig in neue digitale Tools einzuarbeiten
Gespür für politischen Diskurs – du verstehst, welche Themen und welcher Ton in unserem Kontext funktionieren
Interesse daran, technisches Know-how für politische Mobilisierung einzusetzen
Erfahrung im Umgang mit Projektmanagement- und Teamkommunikationstools, wie Trello oder Slack
Hohe Eigenverantwortung, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude an Teamarbeit
Gute Schreib- und Deutschkenntnisse
Verfügbarkeit möglichst ab sofort und vollzeitnah (35h+), aber falls du erst später Zeit hast, bewirb dich trotzdem

Arbeiten mit Sinn & spürbarer gesellschaftlicher Wirkung
Flexibles Arbeiten: Berliner Büro + remote, wie du am besten denkst
Top-Equipment, Produktions-Studio & Tools für professionelle Content-Produktion
Mitgestaltung erwünscht: gute Ideen werden ausprobiert, nicht abgeheftet
Klarheit & Entwicklung: ehrliche Feedbackkultur, strategisches Sparring, Lernen als Standard
Teil eines starken Netzwerks progressiver Akteur*innen
Ein Team mit Haltung, Vertrauen & echter Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe
Regelmäßige Teamtage & Klausuren, um gemeinsam besser zu werden
Faire Vergütung & transparente Rahmenbedingungen

kurzes Motivationsschreiben
